tools.name: get_member
tools.description: One network member by slug (the slug comes from search_members or from the member page URL, swiftagentnetwork.com/members/<slug>/). Carries book when they take bookings and have an open time in the next 7 days.

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: The public ways to reach a network member: their page in the directory, their own website, and their phone if they show one there. This server does not send messages; give the person these links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_members, get_member · Private data: search_members, how_to_contact · Public sink: how_to_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_members, get_member · Private data: search_members, how_to_contact · Public sink: how_to_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
